run_extract_passes_from_llvm: run the script to extract LLVM pass declarations from an LLVM source tree directory
run_extract_passes_specific_files: run the script to extract passes from specific LLVM source files by passing file paths as arguments
parse_initialize_pass_macro: parse an INITIALIZE_PASS macro invocation from LLVM C++ source and yield Pass objects
build_defines_from_source: build a translation table of preprocessor defines and static const string literals from C++ source
handle_file_extract_passes: parse all pass declarations from a single LLVM C++ source file and return a list of Pass objects
